claims: OS Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution DTM intended for landscape-scale analysis.
Grid and contour products use 10km by 10km National Grid tiles.
Grid posts have regular 50m spacing and data is available as ASCII grid with GML 3.2.1.
Each grid tile contains 200 by 200 pixels of 50m by 50m.
Height values are calculated from pixel centres.
Rows run west to east and successive rows move south from the north-west tile origin.
ASCII headers provide ncols, nrows, xllcorner, yllcorner and cellsize.
Height values are supplied to the nearest 0.1m.
GML supplies location, grid spacing, vertical reference and spatial reference metadata.
OS Terrain 50 has GEMINI metadata on a per-tile basis.
Metadata identifies the tile reference, representation type and flying-date information.

quality_guards: Apply north-west row ordering together with lower-left ASCII header semantics when deriving a cell index.
Do not treat a 50m cell-centre value as parcel-boundary survey precision.
Require exact TQ29 tile bytes and two identified cell values before numeric promotion.
Retain per-tile metadata and release lineage when comparing OS Terrain 50 with EA LIDAR.
